24Nov

Tree Lighting Ceremony

Join us for a magical Tree Lighting Ceremony with joyful carol singers, a specially curated festive menu, and one complimentary glass of Mulled Wine to toast the season.

1·8·15Dec

8pm - 10pm

Carol Singers

Gather with friends and loved ones and enjoy the enchanting sounds of our carol singers, filling the evening with festive melodies and Christmas cheer at Cargo Dubai, Pier 7.

25Dec

2pm - 5pm & 8pm - 11pm

Double Christmas Brunch

Celebrate the season with our Double Christmas Brunch, a one-off seasonal brunch menu with all the trimmings. Crackers, mulled wine, everything you miss from home. Free-flowing drinks, a live DJ, breathtaking Dubai Marina views and a special visit from Santa.
